name: Talk test
notes: Finds the zone 2 ceiling on a day without lifting, so the readings are fresh. Each step holds one heart-rate band; at the end of it, count aloud to 20. The highest step where counting stays smooth sets the ceiling. Finish 1.5–2 hours before other training.

steps.title: Warm-up
steps.cue: Build gradually. Sit upright with a loose grip.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.cue: Settle into 115 to 120. Adjust resistance, keep cadence.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.cue: Add a level. Settle into 120 to 125.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.cue: Add a level. Settle into 125 to 130.

steps.title: Cool-down
steps.cue: Spin easily, then stop any watch recording.
